title.en: It knows what you give it

brief.zh: 让模型修好这个 issue，再跑一次测试确认。
brief.en: Get the model to fix this issue, then run the tests to make sure.

t.zh: 就是编码 agent 里的那个大模型：读一段文字，给出一个动作。它读到的那段文字叫上下文。
t.en: is the large model inside a coding agent: it reads some text and gives one action. The text it reads is its context.

t.zh: 现在还没有任何机器替你跑它。你自己决定上下文里放什么，按下「调用」，看它做了什么，再自己跑测试。
t.en: No machine runs it for you yet. You decide what goes into the context, press Call, see what it did, and run the tests yourself.

hint.zh: 先不放文件，调用一次，看它写了什么，再跑测试。
hint.en: Call it once with no file, see what it writes, and run the tests.

hint.zh: issue 里写了要改的文件名。
hint.en: The issue names the file to change.

after.zh: 没看到 addItem 的代码，模型照样写了：它编了一个仓库里不存在的函数。把文件放进上下文，它就写对了。模型只知道上下文里的东西；上下文外面的，它会编。
after.en: Without the code of addItem the model wrote anyway: it made up a function the repository does not have. With the file in its context, it wrote it right. The model knows only what is in its context; what is outside, it makes up.
